name: How do I choose the right contractor for an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a remodeling contractor who is properly insured, maintains positive third-party ratings like an A+ with the Better Business Bureau, and brings hands-on experience to your specific project scope. Look for a contractor who leads the work on-site rather than delegating every task to distant subcontractors. Ask potential contractors how they handle unexpected job site discoveries, who oversees plumbing and electrical partners, and whether they manage both rough framing and finish details like trim and tile. Direct communication with the owner guarantees consistent quality throughout the remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for verified BBB accreditation, direct on-site supervision, clear trade coordination for plumbing and electrical, and proven expertise in finish carpentry and tile.
